description:
Command-line Git information tool

Onefetch is a command-line Git information tool written in Rust that displays project information and code statistics for a local Git repository directly to your terminal.
The tool is completely offline - no network access is required.
What's Changed
New Features
- Add an Activity field with a commits-per-month sparkline by @o2sh in #1902
- Add --activity-months CLI argument to set the activity window by @o2sh in #1905
- Add an Unreleased field with the commits since the last release by @o2sh in #1903
Full Changelog: 3.1.0...3.2.0
